registry.data: Supabase `dietary_sanitation_audits` (one row per facility + month; `results` item key → met / not_met / na, `comments`, `corrections` {action, goal_date, corrected}, `photos` item key → storage paths in private bucket `dietary-audit-photos`; score = met ÷ (met + not met), N/A excluded; <95% = dietary alert + `administrator_notified`). Anon read/insert/update for current and prior month only, no delete. Below 95%, trigger `trg_dietary_audit_retakes` maps Not Met items to dietary in-service modules (`dietary_audit_item_modules`: A→5, cooling items→4, B→2+3, C/D→10, E→11) into `dietary_retake_assignments`; they show as Refresher rows in the In-Service Quiz app (done = pass on/after assigned date) and edge fn `dietary-retake-notify` emails part-time dietary staff + `retake_notify_recipients` (`dining_quiz_config.retake_send_mode` live/test/dry). Every Finish (app sets `finished_at` + `finish_snapshot`) fires `trg_dietary_audit_summary` → edge fn `dietary-audit-summary` emails the Administrator (`audit_summary_recipients`, `audit_summary_mode`; idempotent per finish via `summary_sent_at`). Items mirror the paper form REVISED 10/15/25 (`SECTIONS` in the page — never renumber a key). No PHI
